The club was founded in 1967 following the dissolution of Mġarr Eagles F.C.{{cite web |title=History |url=https://www.mgarrutd.com/?page_id=360 |website=Mġarr United FC |access-date=21 July 2024}} The club's first success came in 2006–2007 when they won the [[Maltese Third Division|BOV Third Division]]. In 2018–2019 the club managed to reach the Second Division play off final but lost to Vittoriosa Stars 3–2 in extra time.{{cite news |last1=Cassar |first1=Chris |title=BOV Div. I: Ogonuppe hat-trick helps ten-man Vittoriosa keep their status|url=https://www.independent.com.mt/articles/2019-05-05/football/BOV-Div-I-Ogonuppe-hat-trick-helps-ten-man-Vittoriosa-keep-their-status-6736207694 |access-date=21 July 2024 |work=The Malta Independent |date=5 May 2019}}{{cite web |title=Vittoriosa Stars retain Division 1 status - maltafootball.com |url=https://www.maltafootball.com/2019/05/05/vittoriosa-stars-retain-division-1-status/ |website=www.maltafootball.com |access-date=21 July 2024 |date=5 May 2019}} They were relegated after finishing 10th in the [[Maltese Challenge League|Maltese Challenge League B]] and played in the [[Maltese National Amateur League]] in the 2022–23 and 2023-24 seasons. They were promoted back to the Maltese Challenge League at the end of the 2023-24 season.{{cite web |title=Tables & Statistics |url=https://www.maltafootball.com/tables-statistics/ |website=maltafootball.com |access-date=21 July 2024 |date=20 September 2020}}{{cite news |title=Mgarr beat Mtarfa to clinch 2023/24 Amateur League title |url=https://matchcentre.mfa.com.mt/articles/general-category/izibet-national-amateur-league-championship-play-off/ |access-date=21 July 2024 |work=Match Centre |date=21 April 2024 |language=en}}"}}
